scope: Saved final tables only; descriptive overlapping events/cells, no acceptance gate or independent holdout.
units: Rates are fractions. Percentage points = 100 * (pattern_rate - control_rate).

q1.rows: H252 all eras/full and drop_best_year; H126 all-era full. Pattern/daily/all/PRIMARY controls.

candidates.formula: Join by candidate_id; count sign(pattern.hit_rate - control.hit_rate). NaN difference is incomparable; no sample filter or top-10 selection. Sum family counts: 12*92=1104 per horizon.

coverage.filters: split=cross-check, era=all, mkt=all; original and its original:C-base-random
coverage.formula: coverage_rate=matched/(matched+unmatched); bounds=matched/episode_n and (matched+unknown)/episode_n; use stored metric-specific known_n for timing.

followup.filters: split_id=cross-check, era=all, mkt=all, group_id=family (original union), horizon=252
followup.path_formula: Within each family and population, path share=sample_n/sum(sample_n across path_category), including unknown path; no cross-family pooling.
followup.flag_formula: nonhit_known_rate=nonhit_triggered_n/nonhit_known_n; hit_cost_known_rate=hit_cost_triggered_n/hit_cost_known_n. Ranges are min/max across 12 families, never pooled counts.
followup.landmark_formula: Exclude return_bin=pooled. Pair triggered/all_false on family, flag_id, landmark, return_bin; retain when both stored hit_rate non-null. Count signs of triggered minus all_false. All 9 flags, 4 landmarks, 4 bins; 1528 comparable cells. both_known_ge100 requires each side known_n>=100.

limitations: Each drop_best_year row removes its own highest-hit-count year, not necessarily the same year as its control.
CRC cross-check period is already exposed; candidates, event sets and landmark cells overlap.
Unknown and censored may overlap; rates with zero denominator stay null.
No source/input hashing, raw-price reads, feature calculation, reselection or research execution.
